title: Waiting-page labels, buttons and dates break at whole words on a narrow screen with large text
why: Lane notes-fix-page (session_013NEJKzjkypcToggneCjJN8), 08:44 CST Nov 9. Source: #2423 round 3 record, comment 6742856907, "Base defects" (on the base from #2383, not from #2423). At 180-260 px wide with 150-300% text: press labels break mid-word ("Dis|miss", "Re|stor|e", "Rep|ly"); "Send ans|wers" breaks at 180@200% and 180-240@300%; the row date breaks as "Answere|d"; folded titles cut to "W…" at 180@300%. Harm: the owner reads the page on a phone, and a broken label slows or misleads a press.
note: Fix: whole-word breaks, or a smaller-label layout at narrow width with zoomed text. The .dcap caption size (14 px at every text size) is out: #2423's fix takes it (lane correction 08:45 CST). Related: step notes-fix-page. Lane session_013NEJL3WMfUf8CyoxsgvqVr started 08:45 CST Nov 9 (coordinator): designer, builder, design reviewer; branched from #2383, merges after #2383. Additions (lane notes-fix-page 10:08 CST Nov 9, from #2423 design fix check at c8f77de46): (1) the .dcap caption item is back in scope: #2423 reverts its rem caption, because growing it alone made it 42 px at 180-200 px with 300% text, larger than the title and cut short. Size .dcap with the text and cap it at the title's size, or let it wrap. (2) The failure line breaks "(permission|-denied)" at 180@100%, 220@150%, 260@200% and 360@300%; the base broke after the hyphen. #2423 names this as a limit that points here. Addition (lane notes-fix-page 10:42 CST Nov 9, from #2423 round 1 review, reviewer haiku, 10:41): tab labels break mid-word ("Question|s", a lone letter on a line) at about 180-190 px with 150% text, 180-230 px at 200% and 180-310 px at 300%. #2423's named limit points here. PR #2450 (coordinator 11:36 CST Nov 9) fixes part; what it leaves out moved to step page-narrow-breaks-rest.
